additional_info.subject: Re: ID0389015-DC/Si-D/PK-[MP / R2 170001520] Multiple Issues CRM:00798001459
additional_info.body:
Hi Sadek,
We need to plan for the site intervention,
I have given soft reboot from SCB and We have observed the logs.
We could see there is welding detection at QA9 and QA10; or may be feedback wire need to be checked.
PLC-Error-Flag 'DC_Coils_MG1-MG2_QA9-10' changed to true - (coil stuck at ON feedback)
We need to check for proper functioning of the Contactor. Also check if there is any welding in the visual inspection.
Also, Since Charger is offline on OCPP, We need to check if There is power at the OCPP Router.
If not, We can suggest for further troubleshooting steps.
We need to have spare Contactor, router and IMD as spare while site intervention.
Do let us know when you are planning for the site intervention.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
